understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked +, completing all levels in sequence.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action when unobstructed. Walls or other objects can block movement, while pushable blocks may move when adjacent and pushed. Multiple pieces can be controlled by clicking their exact pixel/grid position, though clicking the already selected or invalid position has no movement effect; heuristic blocked indicators are not always definitive.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to place every selectable piece simultaneously on the goal tiles marked +, completing all levels in sequence.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one 3-pixel grid cell per directional action when unobstructed. Walls or other objects can block movement, while pushable blocks may move when adjacent and pushed. Multiple pieces can be controlled by clicking their exact pixel/grid position, though clicking the already selected or invalid position has no movement effect; heuristic blocked indicators are not always definitive.
